cohort: 181,738 primiparous women in labor with singleton term fetuses with cephalic presentation in Alberta, Canada from 2007 to 2016
finding: The recent labor guidelines have the potential to substantially reduce the intrapartum cesarean delivery rate in primiparous women with singleton fetuses with cephalic presentation at term if the guidelines are put into practice.
mod_finding: The study suggests that implementation of recent labor guidelines has the potential to reduce the cesarean delivery rate in primiparous women.
